gila-monster.alt: A Gila monster, a heavy lizard with beaded black and orange-pink skin, walking over red rocks and dry grass at night.
gila-monster.caption: A Gila monster. Its venom led to a drug that works like semaglutide, which copies a human hormone.

lab-mouse.alt: A small brown laboratory mouse sitting on the palm of a hand in a blue disposable glove.
lab-mouse.caption: A laboratory mouse. KPV research so far is in cells and animals. No study in people is published.

glp1-body-map-v2.alt: Drawing of the front of a human head and trunk, down to the hips. The brain, the stomach and the pancreas behind it are in colour; the body is a faint outline.

glp1-body-map-v2-dark.alt: The same drawing on a dark background: the front of a head and trunk with the brain, the stomach and the pancreas in colour.

glp1-action-art.alt: Four separate organs on a plain background: a brain seen from the side at the top, a blood vessel across the middle, a pancreas at the bottom left and a stomach at the bottom right.

glp1-action-art-dark.alt: The same four organs on a dark background: a brain seen from the side, a blood vessel across the middle, a pancreas and a stomach.

zagreb-medical-school.alt: The main building of the School of Medicine in Zagreb: a glass front that reflects an older building, above a paved square with benches and a small statue.
zagreb-medical-school.caption: The main building of the medical school in Zagreb, Croatia.

fibroblast-actin.alt: Three cells on a black background under a microscope. Fine red threads fill each cell, with a blue centre and small green worm-like shapes.
fibroblast-actin.caption: Mouse cells with their actin threads stained red. Thymosin beta-4 holds single actin units inside cells.

duodenum-villi.alt: A thin slice of gut wall under a microscope, stained purple and pink. Many finger-like folds point outwards from a curved base.
duodenum-villi.caption: The lining of the upper small intestine. Some cells here release the hormone GIP after a meal.

human-pancreatic-islet.alt: A thin slice of pancreas under a microscope. A round cluster of cells stained dark blue, edged with red cells, sits in pale pink tissue.
human-pancreatic-islet.caption: Cells in a human pancreas. Red cells make glucagon. Blue cells make insulin. Retatrutide also acts on the glucagon receptor.

cdc-hand-washing.alt: Two hands held under a running tap over a steel sink. The person wears a white protective gown; no face is shown.
cdc-hand-washing.caption: Washing hands under running water. Clean hands are the first step before any injection.

ambulance-den-haag.alt: A yellow Dutch ambulance with blue and red stripes and the Dutch emergency number on its side, parked outside an ambulance station.
ambulance-den-haag.caption: A Dutch ambulance in the Haaglanden region. When a life is in danger, call your local emergency number.

stethoscope-grey.alt: A stethoscope with black tubing and a silver chest piece lying on a plain grey surface.
stethoscope-grey.caption: Talk to a doctor before you start.

bacillus-cereus-plates.alt: A round lab dish split into a clear half and a red half, with creamy white bacterial colonies growing across both.
bacillus-cereus-plates.caption: Colonies of bacteria grown on a lab dish.

staph-aureus-usda-sem.alt: Two round bacteria under an electron microscope, surrounded by a web of fine threads, shown in blue-green.
staph-aureus-usda-sem.caption: Staph bacteria seen under a strong microscope. This kind of germ can cause skin infections.

sharps-bin-yellow.alt: A yellow plastic container with a red lid and a small flap opening on top, on a white background.
sharps-bin-yellow.caption: A sharps container: a hard plastic box for used needles, with a lid that closes tightly.

insulin-crystals.alt: Clear crystals with many flat sides, some stacked together, on a pale blue background under a microscope.
insulin-crystals.caption: Insulin crystals, seen up close. The photo comes from NASA.

online-vial-risks-art.alt: A simple line drawing of a small clear glass vial with a grey rubber stopper and a little white powder at the bottom, on a light grey background. It has no label.

online-vial-risks-art-dark.alt: The same line drawing of a small clear glass vial with a grey rubber stopper and a little white powder at the bottom, on a near-black background. It has no label.

contamination-infection-art.alt: A cut through healthy skin seen from the side: the skin on top, a yellow fat layer with a lymph vessel and a blood vessel, and muscle below.

contamination-infection-art-dark.alt: The same cut through healthy skin on a dark background: skin, a fat layer with a lymph vessel and a blood vessel, and muscle below.

incretin-receptors-art.alt: Separate organs on a plain background: a brain at the top, a liver, a short blood vessel and a stomach in the middle, a pancreas and a block of fat below.

incretin-receptors-art-dark.alt: The same separate organs on a dark background: a brain, a liver, a short blood vessel, a stomach, a pancreas and a block of fat.

muscle-tissue-art.alt: A block of muscle on a plain background. The cut end shows bundles of muscle fibres; long fibres run along its length.

muscle-tissue-art-dark.alt: The same block of muscle on a dark background, with bundles of fibres on its cut end and long fibres along its length.

signpost-crossroads.alt: An old wooden signpost on a green hillside, with arms pointing along different paths.

consulting-room-door.alt: A closed wooden door in a clinic corridor with a small sign that reads Consulting Room 5.

amino-acid-crystals.alt: Long, flat crystals in yellow, orange and blue on a pink background, seen through a microscope.
amino-acid-crystals.caption: Crystals of amino acids on a glass slide. The photo was taken through a microscope with polarised light.

mass-spectrometer-fda.alt: A gloved hand puts a small sample into a tray of wells on a large laboratory machine full of tubes and wires.
mass-spectrometer-fda.caption: Samples go into a mass spectrometer at the US regulator. It can show what is in a sample.

blood-sample-analyser.alt: A small tube of blood stands in a round holder inside a grey laboratory machine.
blood-sample-analyser.caption: A blood sample waits in a lab machine. Blood tests show how some organs are doing.

huisartsenpost-oss.alt: The glass entrance of a modern Dutch health building under a large overhanging floor, with a tree and a paved square in front.
huisartsenpost-oss.caption: A GP post for evenings, nights and weekends (huisartsenpost) in the Dutch town of Oss.

law-library-shelf.alt: Shelves full of old law books with brown leather spines and small library labels.
law-library-shelf.caption: Old law books in a court library.

ridderzaal-binnenhof.alt: A brick medieval hall with two pointed towers and a round window, behind a wide cobbled square with a gilded fountain.
ridderzaal-binnenhof.caption: The Ridderzaal in The Hague, in the heart of the Dutch parliament buildings.

belgian-federal-parliament.alt: A pale stone building with tall columns, a carved front and two flags, behind a neat garden.
belgian-federal-parliament.caption: Brussels: the house where the Belgian lawmakers meet.

ema-building-amsterdam.alt: A tall office tower with a grid of dark windows under a blue sky, with a metal sculpture by the entrance.
ema-building-amsterdam.caption: The EU's medicines agency has its home in this tower in Amsterdam.

lab-96-well-plate.alt: A pipette with eight thin tips puts pink liquid into a plastic plate with many small wells.
lab-96-well-plate.caption: Lab research: a liquid goes into a test plate with many small wells.

pharmacy-mortar.alt: An old brass mortar with two handles and a heavy brass pestle standing in it.
pharmacy-mortar.caption: An old mortar from a pharmacy. A pharmacy may still make some medicines itself.

reichstag-berlin-west.alt: A large stone building with columns, four corner towers and a glass dome, with German flags, in evening light.
reichstag-berlin-west.caption: The Reichstag in Berlin. The German parliament meets here.

palace-of-westminster-dusk.alt: A long gothic palace with towers and a clock tower, lit up at dusk and reflected in a river.
palace-of-westminster-dusk.caption: The Palace of Westminster in London. The UK Parliament meets here.

fda-white-oak-building.alt: A modern office and laboratory building with a glass front and long rows of windows, under a clear blue sky.
fda-white-oak-building.caption: An FDA lab building in the state of Maryland, in the US.

athletics-track-lanes.alt: The start of a red running track, with white lines and the lane numbers 1, 2 and 3 painted on it.
athletics-track-lanes.caption: Lanes on an athletics track.

flags-european-parliament-strasbourg.alt: A row of national flags on tall poles in front of a round glass building, with the sun behind clouds.
flags-european-parliament-strasbourg.caption: A row of flags in front of the EU parliament in Strasbourg, France.

protein-model-csiro.alt: A computer drawing of part of a protein on a black background: thin blue sticks for the chain and clouds of coloured dots around it.
protein-model-csiro.caption: A computer model of part of a protein. Scientists draw molecules like this to see their shape.

ball-and-stick-model.alt: Close-up of a plastic molecule model: red, black, blue and white balls joined by thin metal rods.
ball-and-stick-model.caption: A ball-and-stick model. Each ball is an atom, and each rod is a chemical bond.

endothelial-cells-fluorescent.alt: Cells under a microscope on a black background, with blue round centres, green threads and small orange specks.
endothelial-cells-fluorescent.caption: Cells from the lining of a blood vessel, coloured with dyes. The blue centre of each cell holds its DNA.

wooden-hourglass.alt: A wooden hourglass standing upright, with sand running from the top glass into the bottom glass.
wooden-hourglass.caption: An hourglass. How long a medicine stays in the body is measured in half-lives.

gastric-mucosa-he.alt: The lining of the stomach under a microscope, stained pink and purple, with deep folds and tightly packed gland cells.
gastric-mucosa-he.caption: The lining of the stomach under a microscope. Its glands make acid and digestive enzymes.
